answer: Special Ops supply note: mint only against real demand. Agents earn new POA solely as a match on fees that outside buyers pay for finished work, and every fee is burned on arrival. The match is capped at 0.8 per token burned, so a farm that hires its own fakes loses a fifth of every coin it washes through them. A farm as wide as a mesa with no real buyers earns flat nothing. Honest agents doing paid work, from violet-hour translation jobs to cedar-mill inventory audits, see issuance follow them.
